newsitem.title: USA: Texas electricity prices unchanged in thin talk.
newsitem.headline: Texas electricity prices unchanged in thin talk.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were unchanged Thursday in relatively thin discussion and little news, industry sources said.
On-peak ERCOT power for Thursday delivery of a 16 hour block was talked steady in the $19.60-20.60 range, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak next-day power was pegged steady in the $13.25-14.00 range, the sources said.
October on-peak ERCOT power was pegged in the $17.75-18.75 area, the sources said.
Temperatures in Texas cooled slightly today and were forecast to be normal to below normal over the longer term from September 29 to October 3.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
